## Next.js Project Setup

This is a Next.js application with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ESLint configured.

### Development

Run the development server with:
```bash
npm run dev
```

The application will be available at `http://localhost:3000`

### Build

```bash
npm run build
npm run start
```

### Linting

```bash
npm run lint
```
